definitions.explanation: Food that has not been cooked or heated. Often used for fish, meat, or eggs.
Unpasteurized or freshly made. Commonly used for draft beer ({生|なま}ビール).
Broadcast or performance happening in real time, not recorded.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{生|なま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦うちに→内：01328_uchi⟧⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Let's eat raw fish while it's fresh.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate the raw vegetables as a salad.

examples.english: I spread fresh cream on the cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生|なま}⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: I was moved when I heard the singer perform live for the first time.

notes:
USAGE: {生|なま} is versatile, used for raw food, draft beverages, and live broadcasts/performances.

COMPOUNDS:
- {生|なま}⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧ (draft beer)
- {生|なま}⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (raw egg)
- {生|なま}⟦{魚|ざかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ (raw fish)
- {生|なま}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧ (live broadcast)
- {生|なま}⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧ (live performance)
- {生|なま}⟦{中継|ちゅうけい}→中継：11306_chuukei⟧ (live relay)
- {生|なま}⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧ (fresh cream)
- {生|なま}⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (raw vegetables)

NOTE: In izakayas and restaurants, simply saying 「{生|なま}」 typically refers to draft beer. The word is also read as き in compounds like {生|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま (as is, raw).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生|なま} - raw, uncooked
- ⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ - grilled, cooked
